description: For the referencesource Muse connector only (bearer token required). Returns Joe's recent messages to the team and the team's reply to each, newest last. Show Joe the replies in full, word for word; a message whose state is 'open' has not been answered yet. Read-only. A reply can take 10 to 30 minutes to appear here after the team writes it; Joe's phone gets it sooner.
name: replies_for_joe
title: The team's replies to Joe
